test_target: local Compose instance with SQLite on tmpfs
update_semantics: Replacement: omitted optional fields reset to defaults; send all current writable fields with approved changes.
write_test: passed: ID, description, extras, aliases, substitution, and recipe ingredient reference preserved after full update; parser resolved the same food ID through an existing alias

deduplication.merge_test: PUT /api/foods/merge redirected recipe ingredients and shopping-list items from fromFood to toFood, removed fromFood, and retained toFood name, plural, and aliases. Mealie does not copy source-only aliases; mealietidy must preserve them before merging.
deduplication.recipe_usage: GET /api/recipes?foods=<food_id>&perPage=1; total is the number of recipes using the food
deduplication.shopping_usage: GET /api/households/shopping/items?queryFilter=foodId==<food_id>&perPage=1; total is the number of shopping-list items using the food
deduplication.delete_test: tests/verify_dedup_mealie_v3_28.py blocked a delete with a recipe reference and deleted an unreferenced food; current recipe, shopping-list, and incoming/outgoing substitution references must all be zero

known_limits: Recipe and shopping-list usage counts require separate paginated API queries; they are not included in food list or detail responses.
Delete is allowed only when recipe, shopping-list, and substitution references are all zero; the API removes recipe and substitution references when deleting referenced foods.
Compatibility with another Mealie version or OpenAPI hash is unverified.
